```{python}
#| label: fig-player
#| fig-cap: "Marginal distributions of bill dimensions"

from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass
class Player:
  x: float
  y: float
  dx: float
  dy: float

  def update(self) -> None:
    self.x += self.dx
    self.y += self.dy

def main() -> None:
  # create a new Player
  player = Player(x=0.0, y=0.0, dx=1.0, dy=1.0)
  player.update() # <- impure mutation of state "player"!
```
